svg.title: From symmetry to conserved charge
svg.desc: The first theorem gives a conserved current from a continuous global symmetry of the action on solutions of the equations of motion. Constant charge in a fixed region additionally needs zero net boundary flux. The separate second theorem gives identities among equations from local symmetries depending on arbitrary functions.
